DO NOT SCALE DRAWINGS FOR CONSTRUCTION PURPOSES. IN THE EVENT OF OMISSION OF NECESSARY DIMENSION(S),
NOTIFY THE ARCHITECT IN WRITING.
ALL DIMENSIONS ON 1/8", & 1/4" SCALE PLANS ARE TO THE FACE OF MASONRY, CONCRETE, OR THE FACE OF GYPSUM
BOARD, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. ALL MASONRY DIMENSIONS ARE ACTUAL, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
VERIFY ALL DIMENSIONS, CONDITIONS, EXISTING CONSTRUCTION, AND GRADES AT THE JOB SITE. NOTIFY ARCHITECT IN
WRITING OF ANY DISCREPANCIES OR CONFLICTS.
VERIFY SIZE, LOCATION, AND CHARACTERISTICS OF ALL WORK AND EQUIPMENT TO BE INSTALLED OR RELOCATED
WHETHER FURNISHED BY OWNER OR BY CONTRACTOR(S) BEFORE ANY CONSTRUCTION PERTAINING TO SAME HAS
BEGUN.
VERIFY AND COORDINATE THE SIZE AND LOCATION OF ALL THE OPENINGS FOR STRUCTURAL, MECHANICAL, &
ELECTRICAL WORK AND EQUIPMENT WITH ALL TRADES INVOLVED.
DEMOLITION INFORMATION IS SHOWN THROUGHOUT THE DRAWINGS AND IS NOT LIMITED TO THE DEMOLITION
DRAWINGS.
COORDINATE VISUAL APPEARANCE OF ALL ELECTRICAL, MECHANICAL, & PLUMBING WORK AT AREAS W/ EXPOSED
CEILING/STRUCTURE. RUN ALL PIPES, CONDUITS, DUCTWORK, ETC., ORTHOGONAL WITH STRUCTURE W/ ALL TURNS &
BENDS AT 90 DEGREES.
VERIFY THAT REQUIRED OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE CLEARANCES ARE PROVIDED FOR ALL EQUIPMENT ITEMS.
INSTALL ALL ITEMS IN ACCORDANCE W/ THE MANUFACTURER'S WRITTEN INSTRUCTIONS, EXCEPT THAT THE
SPECIFICATIONS HEREIN, WHERE MORE STRINGENT, SHALL SUPERCEDE. NOTIFY THE ARCHITECT IN WRITING OF ANY
CONFLICTS.
REMOVE ROOFING DEBRIS DAILY. STORING DEBRIS OR MATERIALS ON THE ROOF IS NOT ALLOWED. KEEP GROUNDS
CLEAN AND FREE OF DEBRIS AT ALL TIMES.

RESTORE AND COAT EXISTING MODIFIED BITUMINOUS ROOFING SYSTEM WITH APPLICATION OF APPROVED PRIMER AND
SILICONE COATING SYSTEM. PROVIDE WALKWAYS AS INDICATED ON DRAWINGS, INCLUDING ADDITIONAL COATING WITH
APPROVED GRANULES/ AGGREGATE EMBEDDED IN WET COATING. PROVIDE 4" YELLOW SAFETY STRIPE COATING AS
NOTED ON PLANS. EXISTING SKYLIGHT, FLASHING, AND CURB TO REMAIN; PROVIDE CLEAR SEALANT COATING ON
SKYLIGHT.
CONTRACTOR SHALL PERFORM INFRARED MOISTURE SCAN OF EXISTING ROOF PRIOR TO COATING APPLICATION TO
VERIFY SUBSTRATE CONDITIONS AND COMPLY WITH MANUFACTURER WARRANTY REQUIREMENTS. PRIOR MOISTURE
SCAN (MAY 2026) IS PROVIDED FOR REFERENCE IN PROJECT MANUAL; NEW SCAN IS REQUIRED. IDENTIFY, REMOVE, AND
REPLACE ALL WET INSULATION AND DETERIORATED MATERIALS WITH NEW COMPATIBLE ASSEMBLIES, INCLUDING
MODIFIED BITUMEN PATCHING AS REQUIRED. VERIFY SUBSTRATE IS CLEAN, DRY, AND SUITABLE TO RECEIVE COATING.
ONLY DEMO AMOUNT/AREA THAT CAN BE REINSTALLED IN THE SAME DAY TO ENSURE THE EXISTING ROOF REMAINS DRY.
PROJECT CONSISTS OF TARGETED REPAIR AND RESTORATION OF EXISTING BUILDING ENVELOPE SYSTEMS TO ADDRESS
WATER INFILTRATION AND AGING MATERIALS. WORK INCLUDES THE FOLLOWING:
THROUGH-WALL FLASHING REPAIRS: REMOVE AND REPLACE DEFICIENT THROUGH-WALL FLASHING AT SELECT
LOCATIONS. SEE ROOF PLANS FOR EXTENTS; PROVIDE NEW FLASHING WITH END DAMS AND PROPER INTEGRATION WITH
WALL AND ROOF SYSTEMS, BUILDING UP EDGE RISE WALL CURB ELEVATION AS REQUIRED.
ALL MASONRY PARAPET TO MASONRY RISE WALLS TRANSITIONS: REMOVE AND REINSTALL FOR MASONRY AS REQUIRED
TO ACCOMODATE INSTALLATION OF STAINLESS STEEL SADDLE FLASHINGS. SEE ROOF PLANS FOR TRANSITION TYPES.
ROOF DRAINS: PROVIDE RETROFIT DRAIN INSERTS AT EXISTING ROOF DRAINS, INCLUDING PREPARATION OF EXISTING
DRAIN BODIES, INSTALLATION OF INSERTS, AND INTEGRATION WITH ROOFING SYSTEM TO PROVIDE WATERTIGHT
CONNECTIONS. PROVIDE POSITIVE SLOPE AS REQUIRED TO ELIMNATE PONDING AT DRAINS.
MASONRY AND SEALANT REPAIRS: REMOVE AND REPLACE DETERIORATED SEALANT AT CONTROL JOINTS, AND
PENETRATIONS; PREPARE AND REPAIR MASONRY SUBSTRATES AS REQUIRED TO RECEIVE NEW SEALANT, BACKER ROD,
AND BACKERSEAL.
ALL WORK SHALL MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS WATERPROOFING AND AIR BARRIERS AND BE COORDINATED WITH EXISTING
CONSTRUCTION TO PROVIDE POSITIVE DRAINAGE.
NO MODIFICATIONS TO PRIMARY STRUCTURAL SYSTEMS ARE INCLUDED.

headers:
A. RECOAT ALL EXISTING MODIFIED BIT MEMBRANE WITH SILICONE ROOF
COATING PRODUCT OVER BASE COAT.
B. MOISTURE SCAN, CLEAN, AND PRIME PER MANUFACTURER'S GUIDELINES TO
ACHIEVE 20 YEAR NDL WARRANTY MINIMUM.
C. SEAL ALL SEAMS, FLASHING, AND FASTENERS.
D. ALL MTL COPING AND BLOCKING TO REMAIN, UNO ANY NEW PREFIN. ALUM
COPING TO BE SHOP FABRICATED.
E. MAINTAIN CRICKETS BETWEEN ROOF DRAINS, TYP.
F. EXISTING ROOF DRAINS-REMOVE EXISTING CLAMPING RING AND DOME.
REMOVE EXISTING MATERIAL FROM THE DRAIN TO PROVIDE A CLEAN
SUBSTRATE. REPAIR THE SUBSTRATE AROUND THE DRAIN TO PROVIDE A
SMOOTH TRANSITION FROM THE ROOF INTO THE DRAIN. PROVIDE NEW
RETROFIT ROOF DRAIN INSERTS AT ALL DRAINS. REFLASH ALL DRAINS WITH
NEW FLASHING. NO RELOCATION REQ. ALL ROOF DRAINS 6"; FIELD VERIFY
SIZE.
G. ROOF DRAINS SHALL BE WATER TESTED & INSPECTED.
H. ALL DIMENSIONS SHOWN IN THESE DOCUMENTS TO BE FIELD VERIFIED
PRIOR TO BEGINNING INSTALLATION OR CONSTRUCTION WORK OF ANY
BUILDING COMPONENT.
I. REFER TO SHEET G-001 FOR SCOPE OF WORK SUMMARY.
J. REFER TO SHEETS A-510 AND A-511 FOR DETAILS.
